vetSays.line: A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek: "Don't bother picking around the tents. Walk out. The land feeds people who go looking."
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to." The pantry won't fill itself.
💧 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +4 clean.
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek hesitates, then backs off. "Not today. Sorry." (Low trust — reluctant.)
👂 Overheard — A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek: "Good eyes. Keep watching."
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Off to the well — back with a full skin." The pantry won't fill itself.
📋 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek — 🪾 Gather deadfall. They'll report back by next part.
🛡️ Carlos and Brian met them at the door — 2 put down. Carlos, Brian are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ethel just put down Loud-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Ethel, Jason and Nathan met them at the door — 3 put down. Ethel, Jason, Nathan are hurt.
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. An Elder veteran.
The Elder Grief Counselor shifts, seeking a clear lane.
Carlos strikes the Elder Grief Counselor.
The Elder Grief Counselor falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Elder Grief Counselor!
📺 You brought down Elder Grief Counselor. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
You catch Hans telling the fire about Carlos. "You brought down Elder Grief Counselor." The story's already growing.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Concetta just put down Big Big... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Concetta, Catalina and Jesse met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 barely walked away. Concetta, Catalina, Jesse are hurt.
★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Adaeze taught everyone about European Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: European Elder — named and noted.
Adaeze showed Catalina the European Elder — "remember it." Word travels before the lesson cools.
Adaeze drew European Elder in the dirt for the others. It'll wash away. The knowledge won't.

📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Valeria just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
